headline: Luxury demand lifts revenue and profit on higher room rates
summary_short: Leela Palaces' September-2026 quarter operating revenue was ₹4,119M (+33% y/y) with RevPAR of ₹17,225 (+30%) and profit of ₹946M (+27%).
summary_long: Operating EBITDA rose 36% to ₹1,877M with the margin up 118 bps to 46%. Net debt was ₹12,150M, or 1.4x trailing EBITDA versus 1.6x in March 2026. Per trade coverage, room revenue rose 39%, F&B 21% and management fees 76%. Figures come from press coverage, not the exchange filing.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Numbers come from a trade-press article (Hotelier Buzz, dated October 15, 2026) found by web search; the shard event date is October 14. The company's exchange filing was not read. Margin change +118 bps is as stated in that article.
